checkedAlternates.risk: Vitamin C is an antioxidant like Vitamin E.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Vitamin C is water-soluble (group-1), whereas Vitamin E is fat-soluble (group-4).
Folate (B9) belongs with B6 and B12 in the later B-complex group (group-3), distinct from B1/B2 (group-2).
